headline: China’s culture-and-tourism ministry announces AI application pilot designations
summary: China’s Ministry of Culture and Tourism published a notice on 16 October announcing that it had selected “AI+ Culture and Tourism” application pilot projects after applications, recommendations, review and site inspections. It directs recommending units to supervise the selected organizations’ implementation. The notice establishes the designations and oversight instruction, but its linked project list could not be inspected here; no project count, names, funding, deployment or results are asserted.
